$comment: Misconception catalogue. 'implicates' lists skills whose weakness this misconception is evidence of; the detour planner (src/engine/planner.ts) intersects it with the prerequisite closure of the failed skill. Awaiting named human review with the templates that use these tags.

misconceptions.description: Uses sin for the component adjacent to the angle (and cos for the opposite one).

flashcard.front: Force F at θ above the x-axis: x-component?
flashcard.back: F cos θ (adjacent). The y-component is F sin θ.

misconceptions.description: Multiplies by tan θ to get a component.

flashcard.front: Does F tan θ give a component of F?
flashcard.back: No. tan θ = F_y ÷ F_x relates the components to each other.

misconceptions.description: Gives a component's size without its sign.

flashcard.front: A force points west of north. Sign of its x-component (east positive)?

misconceptions.description: Adds vector magnitudes regardless of direction.

flashcard.front: Do vector magnitudes add when the vectors are perpendicular?
flashcard.back: No. |a + b| = √(a² + b²) for perpendicular vectors.

misconceptions.description: Subtracts magnitudes for vectors that are not opposite.

flashcard.back: Only when a and b point in opposite directions.

misconceptions.description: Uses sin θ instead of sin 2θ in the range formula.
Uses the time to the top instead of the whole flight time.

flashcard.front: Is the time to the top the whole flight time?
flashcard.back: No, it's half of it (on level ground).

misconceptions.description: Uses the launch speed instead of its horizontal component.

flashcard.front: Which velocity component carries a projectile sideways?
flashcard.back: The horizontal one, u cos θ, constant without air resistance.
